verdict.rationale: Supermemory's docs describe an official CLI, invoked as `npx supermemory setup`, that detects the project and launches or prints the integration flow for coding agents. However, the only documented use is integration setup, not operating on memories (add, search, delete) from the command line. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands for core memory operations, a full CLI reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: npx supermemory setup # detect project, launch/print integration flow
Set up coding agents to integrate Supermemory — CLI, skill, and docs MCP.
